pair.title: Innostrom access
pair.intro: Connect a metering point with a dynamic tariff via the Innostrom API (Swisspower), e.g. AEW Classic Dynamic.
pair.testCredentialsHint: The public test credentials let you try the app without a contract (constant prices).
pair.errorAuth: Invalid credentials: metering point number or token is wrong.

device.unavailableAuth: Invalid credentials (metering point number or token). Please correct them in the device settings.
device.logAmongCheapestIncomplete: is_among_cheapest: prices in window incomplete, evaluating as false
device.logAmongMostExpensiveIncomplete: is_among_most_expensive: prices in window incomplete, evaluating as false
device.logInCheapestBlockIncomplete: is_in_cheapest_block: prices in window incomplete, evaluating as false
device.errorNoCheapestBlock: No contiguous block of that length found in the time window (data missing).
